title: Shelves, rooms block and running index are absent below 1440
observation: At 1280 the left rail is a 56px strip of unlabelled marks plus `In hand / <1m`: no `IN THIS DOCUMENT`, no `Rooms`, no `THE SHELVES`. `Plan room`, `Spec book`, `Mood boards`, `Call sheet` are not narrowed but removed, and an open shelf is force-closed on crossing below 1440.
already_ruled: C8 (I136 — index/rooms/shelves ≥1440 only)
suggested_fix: Give the compact tier a labelled doorway row per shelf, reusing the existing shelf-open mechanism.

title: At 1280 the spine is an unlabelled 56px icon rail
observation: At 1180-1439 the seven section marks render as bare coloured bars with no printed text; the active section's label is `hidden min-[1440px]:block`, and `StrataMark`'s label becomes aria-label only. `← Put down` loses its word and becomes a bare `←`. The word `Project` appears nowhere in the rail.
already_ruled: C8 (compact tier is an icon rail by width-regime design)
suggested_fix: Print the active section's label and sub in the compact rail, and keep the word on `Put down`.

title: Care-stage FF&E spread is headed `Install`
observation: On Birch Hollow (`Care · ONGOING`, `The book closed Aug 25.`) the FF&E spread's heading is the literal word `Install` and its empty state reads `No FF&E lines are scheduled for installation.` — four lines below a paragraph that correctly reads `Plan the care work`.
already_ruled: C18 (R7 truth device)
suggested_fix: Key the FF&E heading and empty state off `sectionKey`, as `work-block.tsx` already does.

title: Nothing answers a phase-wide question; ⌘K `install` returns No match
observation: ⌘K typed `install` returns only `No match — Browse the Help Center` / `SEARCH THE GUIDES →` and `Ask the Engine · "INSTALL" · ASK & PLACE`, while the Desk behind it prints the folder tab `ASPEN · INSTALL`. No Desk filter, tab or chip groups by phase.
already_ruled: known-open: T2 install-as-label / T4 no fleet view (canon digest §B)
suggested_fix: Match the seven section labels in `matchSurfaces` and add an `Everything in install` grouping to the Desk.

title: FF&E lines print under `Unsorted`, never under a room heading
observation: Chen Residence's head reads `Project · FF&E   1 group · 3 lines`; the one group is named `Unsorted   3 OF 3 UNDERWAY`, and the running index reads `Project · FF&E   3 PIECES · 0 ROOMS`. T4's assumed path — room heading, then line — has nothing to click.
suggested_fix: Make the room the default group; print `Unsorted` only for lines that genuinely have none.

title: Orders ledger shows no PO acknowledgment state
observation: Rows read `AP-012  RECEIVED / INSPECT`, `CER-0044  IN TRANSIT`, and `NOT SENT`; the tabs are `LEDGER  THE WEEK  RECEIVING  VENDORS` and the filters `PAYMENT · ALL  DUE  PENDING  PAID`. No row, chip, tab or filter uses `acknowledged`, `confirmed` or `ack`.
suggested_fix: Print sent-date and an explicit ack state per PO row (`Acknowledged` / `Awaiting ack, {n}d`).

title: The mobile bar's one big act is a truncated `MESSAGE THE CLI…`
observation: At 390 the bar reads `IN THIS DOCUMENT / Project` · `MESSAGE THE CLI…` · `··· MORE`, while the paper's red-letter zone says `Name the phases for this project / OPEN THE SCHEDULE`. Only `document-guide.tsx` registers a mobile primary; `red-letter-zone.tsx` registers none.
already_ruled: C7 (I135's one-leader contract)
suggested_fix: Register the red letter's first row as the mobile primary, and shorten the label rather than truncate.

title: Three-to-four competing doors answer one money question
observation: The `Design authority` head prints `DRAW AN INVOICE`, `AMENDMENT` and `HOURS · THIS PROJECT ↗` side by side; the FF&E head adds `BILL 3 UNINVOICED`, ⌘K adds `Draw an invoice for {Project}` and the Desk's `BEGIN` column a fourth. Nothing signposts which is the door.
already_ruled: C7 (I135 one leader per region)
suggested_fix: Collapse to one scored leader per state and demote the rest under the row overflow.

title: The money region is named `Design authority` and carries no money scent
observation: The folded seam reads `Design authority   NO AUTHORITY YET · $0 COMMITTED   UNFOLD ↓`; unfolded the head is `MONEY · ONE REGION` / `Design authority`. The word money appears only in that small eyebrow, and the running-index row prints `Design authority` alone.
suggested_fix: Pair the studio word with the trade word — `Design authority · money` — including in the running index.

title: The seven g-chords work but are printed nowhere on screen
observation: `g l`, `g p`, `g r`, `g o`, `g a`, `g h`, `g t` all route correctly (probe §3). A full-text sweep of `/desk` and `/doc/[id]` finds no chord hint; the badges print only inside ⌘K rows, which she must open with ⌘K to see. `/` and `?` register no handler at all.
suggested_fix: Print the chord as a mono suffix on each Desk Contents row (`Orders   g o`).

title: Ledger sheet focus-restore silently no-ops from the Studio books menu
observation: Opening Orders from inside the `Studio books` disclosure both opens `DocSheet` and unmounts the disclosure the trigger lived in; `DocSheet`'s guard `if (!focusTarget?.isConnected) return;` then does nothing and focus lands on `<body>` (live-verified).
suggested_fix: Fall back to the still-mounted `Studio books` toggle when the original trigger has detached.

title: The `Knowledge` shelf is a redirect that names itself three ways
observation: The row reads `Knowledge   STUDIO LIBRARY →`; the leaf's eyebrow reads `STUDIO LIBRARY · CROSS-PROJECT`, its body `STUDIO LIBRARY — CROSS-PROJECT STANDARDS. NOTHING FILED FOR THIS PROJECT.`, its act `OPEN THE STUDIO LIBRARY →`. It holds nothing and duplicates a permanent drawer door.
already_ruled: Knowledge naming (known-open, I136)
suggested_fix: Rename the shelf to `Studio library`, or retire the slot and give it to Boards.

title: ⌘K Recent lists two rows both titled `Aspen`
observation: `RECENT` prints `Birch / BIRCH HOLLOW`, `Aspen / ASPEN LOFT REFRESH` and `Aspen / ASPEN LOFT — LIVING ROOM REFRESH` stacked — a live project and a sent proposal sharing the same bold first word, separated only by a smaller sub-label.
suggested_fix: Lead the Recent row with the full title plus its stage (`Aspen · Install`), not a truncated first word.

title: Index, rooms and shelves vanish on install and care documents
observation: On `w1440-doc-install` and `w1440-doc-care` the spine reads `← PUT DOWN`, seven marks, the active label and `● IN HAND / under a min` — no `IN THIS DOCUMENT`, no `Rooms`, no `THE SHELVES`. `DocSpineShelvedBlocks` mounts only when `engagement_kind === 'project' && active_section === 'project'`.
already_ruled: C8 (I136 ratifies the ≥1440 spine, not the section gate)
suggested_fix: Mount the shelved blocks on every project-kind document regardless of `active_section`.

title: The mobile spine sheet lists sections and nothing else
observation: The sheet shows `← PUT DOWN · BACK TO THE DESK`, the seven section rows (`Brief NOT RECORDED` … `Project ACTIVE` … `Care —`), then `IN THE MARGIN · 3` and the margin cards. No running-index row, no `Rooms`, no shelf row of any kind.
already_ruled: C8; D3 mobile spine sheet
suggested_fix: Add the shelves as rows beneath `Rooms` in the mobile spine sheet — they are links, not layout.

title: `Who still owes me` is unanswerable inside the document
observation: The money rows are `Authority`, `Plan`, `Committed`, `Moved · $14,420 in motion`; none is invoiced, paid or outstanding. Receivables sit in a second folded band, `The accounts · this project  $0 BUDGET · $14,420 COMMITTED`, tagged `STUDIO EYES ONLY`. Studio Pulse prints counts, never a total.
already_ruled: adjacent known-open: money doesn't seam on install/care (I141)
suggested_fix: Print `Outstanding · $X · N days` on the money seam, and a studio-wide receivable total on the Desk.

title: Three different things are called a `room`
observation: The drawer's `The Rooms` (`g r`) opens `THE ROOMS · 6 scanned rooms`, cards titled by person (`Lily Tanaka` / `Kitchen · scanned Aug 24`); the spine's `Rooms` block lists FF&E groups; `Plan room` is a shelf of drawings. P4 took `The Rooms` first looking for a sofa and backed out.
already_ruled: C20 (one name per surface, applied to nouns)
suggested_fix: Rename the drawer entry to what it holds (`Scans`), keeping `rooms, scans, room view` as aliases.

title: Five of seven stage default acts are `Review {X}`, a shrug
observation: `stageCopy`'s action labels: `Review the brief`, `Continue Discovery`, `Open Drafting Room`, `Review proposal` / `Review signing controls`, `Review active work`, `Review installation`, `Review closeout`. The default need action is also `Review now`.
suggested_fix: Give each stage a distinct lead verb naming its real next move; never repeat `Review` as the first word.

title: A sent, unopened proposal is invisible on the Desk
observation: The document carries `SENT YESTERDAY —  NUDGE CLIENT USER` and `SENT Aug 24 / OPENED not yet / READING — / MOST READ —`. No Desk folio carries a sent age or unopened state — the visible proposal folio reads `Signed — open the project` — and no roll-up of proposals with the client exists.
already_ruled: C13 (I137 SP3 — the send-wall line's home is inside the document)
suggested_fix: Derive a folio need from sent-age, and add a Desk `proposals with the client` grouping.

title: Nothing on the paper names a PO, receiving or a claim
observation: FF&E lines carry piece, vendor, stamp (`IN PRODUCTION`, `RECEIVED`) and price only; `PO`, `purchase order`, `receiving`, `inspect`, `claim` and `damage` appear nowhere on the paper at any stage. The only in-document door toward orders is the colophon's `BRIEF A VENDOR`.
suggested_fix: Let a line's stamp carry its PO number and open the receiving page for that line.

title: ⌘K never restores focus to its trigger on close
observation: `command-bar.tsx` has one focus line — focusing the input on open — and no capture or restore of the pre-open `document.activeElement`. Live-verified: focus the `Plan room` shelf button, ⌘K, Escape, and focus lands on `<body>`. The shelf leaf, margin panel and ledger sheets all restore correctly.
suggested_fix: Capture `document.activeElement` on open and restore it via `requestAnimationFrame` on close.

title: Flag-off, an absent call sheet looks like an empty crew
observation: With `call-sheet` on the letterhead prints `CALL SHEET · 0`, the shelf row reads `Call sheet   NOBODY ON IT YET →` and the foot band `– You're on the call sheet as lead. Who else is on the job?`. With the flag off none of these mount at all — feature-absent and roster-empty are one picture.
suggested_fix: Keep the roster row present-and-empty when the flag is off (`Nobody on it yet`), or decide the flag.

title: `NEEDS YOUR HAND 8` prints over four folios
observation: The eyebrow reads `NEEDS YOUR HAND  8`; four folio cards render; the footer reads `4 IN REACH · 4 FOLDED BELOW` on the left and `REVEAL 4 MORE FOLIOS ↓` on the right. Identical at 1280 and 390. Half the attention queue is folded on first paint.
suggested_fix: Put the count and the reveal on one line, or fold to eight when eight is the count.

title: The two Desk begin verbs carry no distinguishing sub-label
observation: The header prints `＋ CAPTURE A LEAD` and `＋ OPEN A PROJECT` bare. Their distinguishing sub-labels — `BEGIN A BRIEF` and `NO PROPOSAL NEEDED` — exist only inside ⌘K's `BEGIN` group, and `Capture a lead` is deliberately omitted from the Desk's own `BEGIN` column.
suggested_fix: Print the same sub-label under each Desk header act that ⌘K already carries.

title: A held room has no visible release control once scrolled away
observation: The letterhead's `In hand · {Room}` line is plain text with no × or close affordance; the only release is clicking the same Rooms-block row again. Source-confirmed only — the local seed has no project with both rooms and `active_section='project'` (probe §7).
already_ruled: C8
suggested_fix: Add a release control to the letterhead's `In hand` line itself.

title: The money explainer is a dense paragraph that names its own old UI
observation: Beneath four terse label rows sits one unbroken paragraph: `Authority → plan → committed → moved. Moved is the accounts' committed figure … not funds disbursed…` ending `Absorbs today's four separate bands: design authority, working budget, authorizations & trade scopes, the accounts.`
suggested_fix: Cut the `Absorbs today's four separate bands` sentence and break the gloss into the rows' own rhythm.

title: The install spread shows no FF&E lines at all
observation: `w1440-doc-install` prints, under `Install`, one line: `No FF&E lines are scheduled for installation.` The same project's lines are visible and priced on the project spread. The spread offers `ADD THE FIRST TASK` and `INSTALL WINDOW / No window is held. HOLD A WINDOW` instead.
suggested_fix: Show the project's FF&E lines on the install spread, filtered to arrivals, rather than an empty state.

title: At 390 the `ADD TO PROJECT` plate covers the FF&E heading
observation: The heading wraps to three lines (`Pro` / `·` / `FF&E`) and the solid dark scored-ink `ADD TO PROJECT` leader sits directly on top of the middle line, physically covering `ject` — confirmed by pixel crop of `m390-doc-project-rich.png` (y≈3280-3600).
suggested_fix: Below 1180 stack the region heading above its leader instead of right-aligning them on one line.

title: The roster cannot be reached from the Desk at all
observation: `Call sheet` is `scope: 'document'` and is filtered out of Desk Contents, out of ⌘K's unfiltered `Rooms & ledgers` group, and out of typed ⌘K unless a project document is in hand. Desk Contents prints `ROOMS: Library · People · The Rooms` — `People` is the studio directory, not this job's roster.
already_ruled: C15 (R95 — Contents = labels + doorways only)
suggested_fix: Add a per-folio roster glance to the Desk and a cross-project roster question to ⌘K.

title: The Mood boards shelf opens onto another fold, with no way to start one
observation: Clicking `Mood boards / NO BOARDS YET →` opens a leaf headed `MOOD BOARDS · SHARED & DRAFT` / `Mood boards` / `✕ CLOSE` whose entire body is one more folded row: `Mood boards   NO BOARDS YET   UNFOLD ↓`. No `Start a board`. The Plan room leaf ends in `Open the plan room`.
suggested_fix: Render the board list — or the empty line plus `Start a board` — unfolded inside the leaf.

title: The downstream damage of a date move is prose, not a preview
observation: The install schedule prints `PHASE HANDOFFS` / `Completing a phase activates every direct follower in the project graph. The server verifies blockers and the exact transition.` and one act, `COMPLETE PHASE`. No reviewed shot shows a date-edit control paired with a ripple preview.
suggested_fix: Show the followers a date move will touch, inline, before the commit.

title: The Worktable moves no item-reach cell and leaves install week untouched
observation: `wt-delivery-project-1440` and `wt-delivery-install-1440` are composition-identical to their flag-off twins: same shelf-less spine, same `No FF&E lines are scheduled for installation.`, same `INSTALL WINDOW`, same `ADD A ROOM`. The new tools land on Intake and Speccing — before the project starts.
already_ruled: C14 (Q3/I138 — the Worktable is the destination)
suggested_fix: Give the Delivery table an install setting that shows arrivals, exceptions and the roster.

title: ⌘K's placeholder and fallback both invite `ask the Engine`
observation: The input placeholder reads `Find a document or a ledger — or ask the Engine…`; the no-match group eyebrow reads `Ask the Engine` and its results header `The Engine · "{query}"` with the row sublabel `'{query}' · ask & place`. This is the first text a designer reads inside search.
suggested_fix: Drop `Engine` from every visible string; `Find a document or a ledger…` is complete on its own.

title: The FF&E head leads with `ADD TO PROJECT` and shows three acts at once
observation: The head's ledger prints, in order: `ADD TO PROJECT` (filled dark plate), `BILL 3 UNINVOICED` (scored underline), `SPEC BOOK →` (scored underline), `FOLD ↑`. On a project with three lines already in production, the inked leader asks her to add a fourth.
already_ruled: C7 (I135 one leader per region); I141 demotes the head when the release lift shows
suggested_fix: Elect the leader from state — `Bill n uninvoiced` or `Release for authorization` when either applies.

title: Two regions on one paper are both called `Schedule`
observation: About 120px apart the paper prints a fold seam `Schedule … UNFOLD ↓` (the Rule, `schedule-rule-title`) and a region head `Schedule / 0 phases · nothing active · next milestone —  FOLD ↑` (the ledger, `project-schedule-title`). The index carries one row, wired to the ledger only.
already_ruled: C11 (I137 — the index is derived from mount order)
suggested_fix: Name the Rule for what it is (`Phase dates`) and leave `Schedule` to the ledger.

title: The proposal guide says `Review signing controls` instead of the live act
observation: The sent-proposal fallthrough prints headline `Wait for the client's signature` with action `REVIEW SIGNING CONTROLS`; the real act, `NUDGE CLIENT USER`, sits ~200px lower. The same phrase serves the draft-fallback branch, and `Review countersign controls` the client_signed branch.
suggested_fix: Name the actual control per state — `Nudge Client User`, `Send for signature`, `Countersign the agreement`.

title: ⌘K opens on Recent and Begin; the doorways are below the fold
observation: The visible palette shows `RECENT` (Birch, Aspen, Aspen) then `BEGIN` (`Capture a lead`, `Open a project`, `Draft a design agreement`, `Draw an invoice`, `Add a maker`) and ends. `This surface`, `Rooms & ledgers` and `Studio` — home of `The plan room` — are pushed off-screen.
suggested_fix: Order `This surface` above `Recent` when a document is in hand.

title: Desk Contents names doors without saying what is behind them
observation: `THE STUDIO` prints three columns — `ROOMS: Library ↗ / People ↗ / The Rooms ↗`, `LEDGERS: Orders SHEET / Accounts SHEET / Hours SHEET / The Post SHEET`, `BEGIN: …`. `SHEET` is the only sub-label and describes presentation, not contents; nothing says receiving or damage claims live under `Orders`.
already_ruled: C15 (R95 forbids counts/tiles/metrics — a static sub-label is neither)
suggested_fix: Give each ledger row the registry `subLabel` it already carries in ⌘K (`Orders · POs, receiving, vendors`).

title: Studio pulse is folded by default and names nothing
observation: `STUDIO PULSE` / `4 moving · 3 reconnecting · Field quiet` / `1 decision is overdue, and 4 pieces are on the way.` / `7 STUDIO ITEMS   OPEN PULSE ↓`. No project name, no phase, no due date, and `reconnecting` carries no inline gloss — the one cross-project organ is a folded adjective.
suggested_fix: Print the two most time-sensitive items by name in the folded state.

title: A folded region and an empty one read the same
observation: Chen's seams read `Client approvals   NO DECISION LEAD · NO APPROVALS AUTHORED   UNFOLD ↓`, `Schedule   UNFOLD ↓`, `Design authority   NO AUTHORITY YET · $0 COMMITTED   UNFOLD ↓`. Folds persist in `patina:doc-fold:<docId>:<region>`, so a region folded ten days ago still reads as a line of zeroes.
suggested_fix: Mark a seam folded by her hand differently from one folded because it is empty.

title: Setup chores and dated overdue needs wear the same red-letter clothes
observation: On Chen the band reads `NEEDS ATTENTION · IN ONE PLACE` / `Name the phases for this project` / `OPEN THE SCHEDULE`; on Aspen the identical band reads `1 decision overdue — oldest due Aug 22` / `REVIEW DECISIONS`. The same terracotta tags routine folio tabs and `DECISION DUE` chips.
already_ruled: D8 forbids badges but does not govern hue reuse
suggested_fix: Print the age on the line, and reserve the red-letter hue for the Needs Attention zone alone.

title: Seven section names and `The Patina Six` both print on one paper
observation: The spine's chrome uses Brief/Discovery/Direction/Proposal/Project/Install/Care, while the same document's Schedule region prints, verbatim: `Consultation · Schematic Design · Design Development · Procurement & Orders · Installation & Styling · Completion — the studio's standard six.`
already_ruled: I114 (known-open, section↔stage mapping)
suggested_fix: Owed to the I114 session; short of that, reconcile the two vocabularies at first mention.

title: The guide's act names a different verb than the row beneath it
observation: The guide's action reads `ADD PROJECT TYPE AND NAMED ROOMS` under the headline `Complete Discovery`; the first checklist row directly below is labelled `Scope & rooms`. One input, three names, adjacent on screen.
suggested_fix: Let `withInputs` rewrite the headline too, and reuse the checklist row's own label as the action text.

title: Brief chips print raw template text (`15k_50k`, `3 6 Months`)
observation: The BUDGET chip reads `15k_50k` (literal underscore) and the TIMELINE chip reads `3 6 Months` (missing separator) — the facts a fast read of T1/T3 depends on, printed unformatted.
suggested_fix: Format as `$15k–$50k` and `3–6 months` before printing.

title: Opening a shelf re-wraps the paper she was reading
observation: With the Spec book or Knowledge leaf open the FF&E head wraps to two lines — `Project ·` / `FF&E` — and its status truncates to `1 group · 3 li…`. Closed, the same head sits on one line. The leaf is declared non-modal, yet the reading position visibly moves under it.
already_ruled: C8 / C1 (I136 exempts reference material from D1's split-view ban)
suggested_fix: Overlay the leaf rather than reflowing the paper column.

title: The Orders sheet prints `PUT BACK · ESC` twice
observation: `PUT BACK · ESC` appears once at the top-right of the screen and again inside the dialog's own `ORDERS · LEDGER` header row, stacked directly above each other.
suggested_fix: Print the hint once.

title: `The Post` shows `3 NEW` on mobile and an unlabelled dot on desktop
surface: mobile More menu vs Studio Drawer
observation: The 390 `More` menu prints `The Post   3 NEW`; the ≥1180 drawer prints `THE POST` with an unlabelled dot. The same object reports a count at one width and a state at another.
already_ruled: C4 (D8 — no badges, no pulsing counts)
suggested_fix: Pick one.

title: Spec book has no door on install or care
observation: The `Spec book →` link renders inside `{mode === 'project' && …}`; in `mode === 'install'` the head prints only `Install` plus meta. There is no spec-book entry in `STUDIO_ROOMS`/`LEDGERS`/`VERBS`, so `matchSurfaces` cannot find it and ⌘K has no spec-book row in either branch.
suggested_fix: Keep the `Spec book →` head link in install mode and add spec-book aliases to a registry entry.

title: No visible way to open ⌘K anywhere on a phone
observation: The mobile bar's left third, centre and `More` menu (`Time in hand`, `The Post`, `Studio books`, `Leave a note`) contain no search or find affordance, and no mobile component calls the command-bar opener. ⌘K is the stated fallback door below 1440, and it has no entry point.
already_ruled: C8
suggested_fix: Give the mobile `More` menu a `Find anything` row that opens the same Command Bar.

title: The plan room disappears from ⌘K the moment she types `plan`
observation: `The plan room` · `this project · the current set` enters the `This surface` group only in the empty-query branch and carries `match: ''`. The typed branch never re-adds those rows and `matchSurfaces()` has no plan-room entry, so typing `plan room` returns `No match — Browse the Help Center`.
suggested_fix: Give `The plan room` a real `match` string and include `This surface` rows in the typed filter.

title: The Drafting Room's only Desk doorway is ⌘K
observation: The Drafting Room is explicitly excluded from Desk Contents' Begin list and reachable only via ⌘K → `Open the Drafting Room`. A keyboard user unaware of ⌘K has no path in from the Desk at all.
suggested_fix: Add the row to Desk Contents' Begin list, or distinguish it from `Capture a lead` in the header acts.

title: `MESSAGE THE CLIENT` leads the letterhead on a doc with no client
observation: Chen Residence prints title, then `No client linked — attach one ↗`, then `MESSAGE THE CLIENT · PREVIEW AS THE CLIENT · SHARING · MILESTONES · CALL SHEET · 0` with `MESSAGE THE CLIENT` inked as leader. `canSendNote = Boolean(projectId || clientProfileId)` never asks whether a client exists.
already_ruled: C18 (R7 — stamps only say true things)
suggested_fix: When no client is linked, the leader becomes `Attach a client`.

title: Answering a client question happens off the document
observation: The paper offers `MESSAGE THE CLIENT`, an outbound composer captioned `The Pulse handles Fridays; this is for now. It lands in {client}'s portal messages.` Her question lives behind `THE POST` (dot only) or `/people?thread=`. Chen's margin holds no message kind at all.
suggested_fix: Land an unanswered client message as a margin item on its project's paper, with reply in place.

title: The rooms rail exists on direction and disappears on the project
observation: `wt-speccing-1440` (a direction document) carries `ROOMS   All   + Add a room` above the scheme, plus `BOARDS / START A BOARD` and `Reach into the library…`. `wt-delivery-project-1440` carries none of them; its FF&E group is still `Unsorted` and its room verb is the foot-of-list `ADD A ROOM`.
suggested_fix: Carry the rooms rail forward onto the Delivery table.

title: No bypass-blocks control anywhere in the layout
observation: The `(document)` layout mounts the route boundary, five providers, the route, LogStrip, StudioDrawer, RegistryShortcuts, CommandBar and the mobile shell; a grep for `skip to` / `SkipLink` across the document app and components returns zero hits. A Tab-only user traverses the whole spine each load.
suggested_fix: One visually-hidden, focus-visible `Skip to the paper` link as the first focusable element in layout.tsx.

title: Terracotta and clay ink fail 1.4.3 contrast everywhere they appear
observation: `--color-terracotta: #D4A090` and `--color-clay: #C4A57B` are used as text in 394 places against `--doc-paper: #FCFAF6` / `#FFFFFF`: computed ≈2.18:1, 2.27:1 and 2.24:1, under AA's 4.5:1 and under 3:1. This is the ink for `NEEDS ATTENTION · IN ONE PLACE`, every `role="alert"` band and `OVERDUE`.
suggested_fix: Darken both tokens for text use, keeping the lighter values for fills and borders.

title: The FF&E line she must edit is not editable on the paper
observation: A line prints `Møbler Lounge Chair — Bouclé · ×2 / Nordic Atelier` · `IN PRODUCTION` · `$5,700` and nothing else. `Sku / Finish / Material / Color Fabric / Exact Location` live in the Spec Book route, a full-screen room whose return restores neither scroll position nor fold state.
already_ruled: C1/D14 (the Room-vs-Sheet weight is ruled; the round-trip cost is not)
suggested_fix: Give the row's `···` overflow a `Specify…` act opening the spec fields as a sheet over the document.

title: The same FF&E line reads `RECEIVED` on paper and `DELIVERED` in the spec book
surface: /doc/[id] FF&E region vs Spec book shelf leaf
observation: On the paper `Custom Walnut Sectional — 3 pc` carries the stamp `RECEIVED`; two clicks later the Spec book shelf leaf prints the same line as `DELIVERED $6,800`. Received-not-yet-installed and delivered are different real-world states, told about one piece at one moment.
suggested_fix: Derive both surfaces' status from one source and print one word per line.

title: `Committed` means $0 in one region and $14,420 in another
surface: /doc/[id] Design authority region vs `The accounts` seam
observation: The `Design authority` region's own `Committed` row reads `nothing executed yet` ($0), while the folded seam `The accounts · this project` three screens down prints `$0 BUDGET · $14,420 COMMITTED · 20% MARGIN`. One money word, two numbers, one document.
suggested_fix: Use one definition of `Committed` per document, or name the two figures differently.

title: The room lens has no substitute below 1440
observation: The only mechanism to hold a room and lift it across the FF&E list is the ≥1440 spine Rooms block; a live resize below 1440 auto-releases any held room (`room-lens-context.tsx`: "there is no put-down affordance under the full spine"). No filter, chip or search-by-room exists at 1280 or 390.
already_ruled: C8 (room lens is part of the shelved-spine ≥1440 restriction)
suggested_fix: A lightweight room filter above the FF&E list at 1180-1439 restores the ≤2-act path.

title: The index says `NO AUTHORITY YET` over $14,420 in motion
observation: The running-index row reads `Design authority / NO AUTHORITY YET`. Unfolding the same region prints `Moved · $14,420 in motion — ordered through installed` and an accounts band `The accounts · this project  $0 BUDGET · $14,420 COMMITTED · 20% MARGIN`. The index reports the one tier that is empty.
suggested_fix: Let the index value fall back to the strongest non-empty tier (`$14,420 committed`).

title: Boards have three doors with three different names
observation: `Mood boards` (spine shelf, ≥1440, project stage), `RECENT BOARDS` (Desk strip) and — flag-on, direction stage only — `BOARDS / START A BOARD` on the paper. The Drafting Room registry entry also aliases `boards, moodboards`. Three doors, none open at the same time as either other.
already_ruled: C9 (I139/Q1 — boards on the paper for speccing only)
suggested_fix: Use one name — `Mood boards` — in all three places.

title: Three `add a room` verbs mean three different things
observation: Flag-off, `ADD A ROOM` prints at the foot of the FF&E room list (adds an FF&E group). Flag-on, the Speccing table's rail prints `ROOMS  All  + Add a room` at the top of the paper (adds a room to the scheme). `/rooms` is a gallery of scanned rooms with no add verb at all.
already_ruled: C12 (I137 SP4 rules where the FF&E one lives)
suggested_fix: The Speccing rail's verb becomes `+ Room to the scheme`.

title: Two acts open the same Drafting Room, worded differently
observation: The guide's action reads `OPEN DRAFTING ROOM`. Directly below it the Direction·v1 block prints its own act, `CONTINUE DRAFTING`, for the same destination (`Not started yet — open the Drafting Room to write it`). Both scored, both live, ~250px apart on one screen.
already_ruled: C7
suggested_fix: Let one block carry the leader for this stage and drop the duplicate act.

title: Nothing on the Desk says what changed while she was gone
observation: The Desk prints a greeting, the date, `NEEDS YOUR HAND 8`, folio cards with need lines, and `STUDIO PULSE  4 moving · 3 reconnecting · Field quiet`. No folio carries an age, no line is marked new, and the pulse counts are levels rather than changes.
suggested_fix: Stamp each folio's need with the day it arrived, as the need text already does (`oldest due Aug 22`).

title: The Drafting Room uses a different visual language from the paper
observation: Scope/Vision/Offer facets (`Rooms`, `FF&E`, `Palette`, `Boards`, `Phases`, `Exclusions`, `Payments`, `Terms`) each render inside a bordered, rounded card with a checkbox and chevron; `+ Add Room` and `ESTIMATE · ROM ESTIMATE` render as pills — none of it the paper's scored-ink language.
already_ruled: C2/C6 govern the document surface; whether the Drafting Room is bound is not explicit
suggested_fix: Bring the facet rows into scored ink, or rule the Drafting Room a distinct workshop register.

title: Orders is a global cross-project ledger, not a project-scoped view
observation: The door (`g o` or Studio books → Orders) opens a studio-wide sheet filterable by `PROJECT · ALL / CHEN RESIDENCE / OLSEN LAKE HOUSE`. T13's bar is ack state per PO without leaving the project's frame; she must instead consult and filter a cross-project register.
already_ruled: C4
suggested_fix: Pre-filter the Orders sheet to the open project when it is launched from inside a document.

title: `CLOSE THE BOOK` looks equally clickable while blockers are listed above
observation: On Aspen Loft Refresh (install) the band reads `1 of 6 closed out` and lists `OPERATIONAL CLOSEOUT STILL OPEN — 2 project phases not completed · 3 coordination items unresolved` directly above a filled `CLOSE THE BOOK` button rendered in the same weight as any other available act.
suggested_fix: Give the act a plainly inert style until its listed blockers clear.

title: `BEGIN THE DIRECTION` is offered live with 0 of 5 essentials captured
observation: The Discovery band reads `0 of 5 essentials captured — keep going` with `BEGIN THE DIRECTION` printed in the same scored, apparently-live style directly beside it — no visible warning of what is incomplete or what advancing skips.
suggested_fix: Show what carries forward incomplete, or grey the act until a minimum is captured.

title: Three equal Worktable add-actions get three different visual weights
observation: `+ Add Item` renders as a solid tan-filled box, `+ Add Allowance` as a white-bordered box and `+ Add TBD` as plain unstyled text — three conceptually parallel ways to start a scheme line, under copy that reads `The scheme starts loose — a first line is enough`.
already_ruled: I135's one-leader rule governs region heads, not a same-row action trio
suggested_fix: Give all three the same visual weight unless one is genuinely meant to be the default.

title: Intake's `opens when…` seams point at the wrong stages
observation: Flag-on, the brief document ends with three inert rows: `Schedule  OPENS WHEN THE PROJECT BEGINS`, `Project · FF&E  OPENS WITH THE DIRECTION`, `Design authority  OPENS WHEN THE PROJECT BEGINS`. That device is what the install and care spreads need and lack — they lose regions silently.
suggested_fix: Reuse `IntakeFutureSeams`' grammar for what a stage has closed — `Project · FF&E · moved to the spec book →`.

title: The Rooms block disappears at zero rooms with no placeholder
observation: On Chen Residence (0 `project_rooms`) the spine jumps from `IN THIS DOCUMENT` straight to `THE SHELVES` with no `Rooms` heading or row — while every shelf in the same block prints its own placeholder even when empty (`Plan room · Nothing filed`, `Mood boards · No boards yet`).
suggested_fix: Give Rooms the same `Take a room in hand · nothing hides` placeholder row the shelves already use.

title: One boxed control breaks the flat scored-ink grammar
observation: `Sync from the schedule` renders inside a visible rounded-corner bordered box — the only bordered button on the whole page — while every other act on the same region (`Draw an invoice`, `Amendment`, `Hours · this project`, `Draft a trade scope`) is a bare underlined DM-mono word.
already_ruled: C6 (scored ink — no boxes/borders/fills for DocumentAction)
suggested_fix: Restyle `Sync from the schedule` as a scored-ink word like its siblings.

title: The drawer is hidden below 1180; Orders costs 2+ taps at 390
observation: The persistent Studio Drawer strip that gives one-tap or one-chord access to Orders/Accounts/Hours/The Post at ≥1180 is hidden below 1180; at 390 the same ledgers are reachable only via the mobile bar's `More` menu → `Studio books` → a book row.
suggested_fix: Surface Orders and Accounts as direct rows in the mobile bar's primary menu.

title: The guide's need-reason reads as a system log, not her voice
observation: The needs-attention branch prints, verbatim: `This action comes from the operational signals available on the current document.`
suggested_fix: Print the specific reason (already available as `need.text`) or drop the generic sentence entirely.

title: The money row `Moved` is not decodable from the word alone
observation: The fourth money row reads only `Moved · $14,420 in motion — ordered through installed`, with a full explanatory paragraph required below to learn it means the accounts' committed figure and explicitly not funds disbursed.
suggested_fix: Rename the row to something self-explanatory, e.g. `In motion`, which its own sub-line already uses.

title: The Care-stage document shows no guide headline at all
observation: On Birch Hollow, between the letterhead vitals row and the `MESSAGE CLIENT USER / PREVIEW AS CLIENT USER` instruments row, no eyebrow, headline, reason or action block is visible — the page goes from vitals straight to instruments with nothing narrating what is next.
suggested_fix: Ensure the plain `stageCopy` default still renders when no need derives.

title: The compact-tier margin is a closed, unlabelled `MARGIN ←` tab
observation: At 1180-1439 the right column that shows live margin items (decisions, vendor payments, notes) at ≥1440 collapses to a single fixed tab reading `MARGIN ←` with no count and no preview of what is inside.
already_ruled: D8 forbids badges generally; a plain count on a closed trigger was not itself ruled
suggested_fix: Print an item count on the closed tab (`MARGIN · 3 ←`), as the mobile spine sheet already does.

title: Unsent POs carry the same visual weight as routine status
observation: `NOT SENT` renders in the same bordered chip style as `RECEIVED / INSPECT` and `IN TRANSIT` — no colour or weight difference signals a PO sitting unsent while a vendor price expires.
suggested_fix: Escalate the visual weight of an aged `NOT SENT` PO, using the red-letter zone's badge-free vocabulary.

title: The full spec-book workbench shows no order or PO status
observation: `OPEN THE SPEC BOOK →` lands on the full workbench, which prints spec completeness only — `Sku / Finish / Material / Color Fabric / Selected Dimensions / Exact Location`, all `Not specified`, plus `INCOMPLETE` — and drops order status entirely, unlike the paper and the shelf leaf.
suggested_fix: Carry the line's order status onto the spec-book workbench row.

title: `No client linked` silently blocks the money and approvals chain
observation: Chen Residence's subtitle reads `No client linked — attach one ↗` while the `Design authority` region and `Client approvals` both print as if available; nothing on either region says the chain cannot complete until a client is attached.
suggested_fix: Say on the money and approvals regions that they wait on a linked client.

title: Every project artifact is behind opening the document first
observation: The reachability inventory records the Call Sheet, the Drafting Room's direct route, the plan room, the spec book and every shelf leaf as reachable only from an open document. From `/desk`, `pull up the primary bedroom board` is four acts, and only at ≥1440 on a project-section document.
already_ruled: C1 (D1 forbids split views, not a Desk door that opens a document at an artifact)
suggested_fix: Let a Desk folio's ledger act deep-link to a region or artifact, as `need.deepLink` already does.

title: `The Post` and `Message {Family}` name the same idea differently
observation: The inbox door is labelled `The Post` (a postal noun); the letterhead's own reply action is labelled `Message {Family}` (a plain verb). Both concern client correspondence, and nothing ties the two words together.
suggested_fix: Keep `The Post` as the studio idiom but add the sub-label `messages` wherever it appears outside the drawer.

title: The Worktable's on-paper boards strip exists only at the Speccing table
observation: `wt-speccing-1440` shows `Boards` with `START A BOARD` printed directly on the paper; `wt-delivery-project-1440` — a signed project at Chen's stage — still shows boards only via the ≥1440 shelf, identical to flag-off.
already_ruled: C9 (Q1 boards-strip reversal is speccing-only by ratified rule)
suggested_fix: Not a defect against doctrine — note that T5's own scenario gains nothing from the Worktable.

title: The Capture Inbox introduces a new bordered card pattern
observation: The Capture Inbox's five pending vendor captures each render as a bordered card with a coloured thumbnail swatch, vendor name, source domain and a relative timestamp — a bordered card pattern that appears nowhere on the flag-off paper.
suggested_fix: Audit how many distinct visual vocabularies the table introduces and consolidate those that need not differ.

title: The Desk header cramps and wraps at 390
observation: `Good afternoon,` breaks after the comma and `Leah` drops to its own line (three lines of greeting) directly above `+ CAPTURE A LEAD` / `+ OPEN A PROJECT` / `FIND ANYTHING ⌘K`, which stack immediately below with very little breathing room, pushing the first folio card mostly below the fold.
suggested_fix: Shorten the mobile greeting to one line and give the header acts a clear top margin.

title: Region status text truncates mid-word at 390
observation: `Client approvals — NO DECISION LEAD · N…` is cut off mid-word with an ellipsis, losing the rest of the status line — which is exactly what tells her whether the region needs anything.
suggested_fix: Wrap the status line to a second line at narrow widths instead of truncating.

title: The Record has no footprint before the first completion
observation: On Chen Residence (no completed sections) there is no `Previous work · N complete` line anywhere between `Design authority` and `Closing the book` — the foot runs straight from the accounts strip to the kickoff band, with no placeholder hinting the device exists.
suggested_fix: Apply the Worktable Intake table's quiet teaser-row treatment to the empty Record.

title: An unexplained circular badge overlaps page content
observation: A small black circle containing `N` sits fixed at the bottom-left of nearly every capture, overlapping the Studio Drawer's `Patina` wordmark (leaving only `INA` legible) and sitting over document content in several full-page shots.
suggested_fix: Confirm whether this is the Next.js dev indicator; if real chrome, reposition it away from the wordmark.

title: Canon's `The Record` never prints on screen
observation: DECISIONS.md names this region `The Record` (I137: "The Record moves to the foot of the paper"), but the only visible string is `Previous work · {n} complete` — `The Record` appears nowhere in the rendered DOM.
suggested_fix: Standardise on `Previous work` everywhere, including future canon entries.

title: `Next up` appears only when guidance is broken
observation: The eyebrow string `Next up` is used exactly once, on the `unavailable` (error) branch under the headline `Guidance is unavailable`; every healthy state uses a different, stage-specific eyebrow instead.
suggested_fix: Print one stable kicker above every guide instance so a designer scanning many documents finds one anchor.

title: `Add to project` and `Open a project` share a word, not a meaning
observation: FF&E's ledger act reads `Add to project` (adds a line, board or import to the current engagement); the Desk header act and ⌘K verb read `Open a project` (starts an entirely new engagement, `no proposal needed`). Both can appear together in ⌘K results.
suggested_fix: Rename the FF&E act to something that does not restate `project`, e.g. `Add to the schedule`.

title: The colophon's `Team…` is the one vague act among plain verbs
observation: Colophon actions read `Brief a vendor`, `Hold`, `Archive` and `Team…` — the first three are plain imperatives naming their result; `Team…` is a noun with a trailing ellipsis and never says it opens the Call Sheet picker.
suggested_fix: Rename to a verb matching its neighbours, e.g. `Add to the team`.

title: Canon's `Contents Page` prints on screen as `THE STUDIO`
observation: R95 names this block a typographic contents of rooms, ledgers and begin-verbs; the actual on-screen eyebrow directly above it reads `THE STUDIO`, not `Contents` in any form.
suggested_fix: No UI change — correct future canon references to call it `The Studio`.

title: The spine's mark count changes between documents
observation: The spine's mark row prints seven marks on a project document, four on the sent proposal and six on the brief. Since the marks carry no visible labels at any width and no ordinal, the same visual device reads as a different scale on each document she picks up in a morning.
suggested_fix: Print all seven marks always, greying the ones this engagement kind will never reach.

title: The money region is folded by default
observation: `Design authority · no authority yet` prints as a fold seam (`UNFOLD ↓`) on Chen Residence; the `DRAW AN INVOICE` act is only visible after that click.
suggested_fix: Auto-unfold Design authority whenever money is owed or overdue, matching the AccountBand exception.

title: The margin rail has no functional closed state at ≥1440
observation: `isFullRail` is always true above 1440, so the `margin-open` and `margin-closed` screenshots are pixel-identical — the rail is permanently mounted and cannot be collapsed, unlike the 1180-1439 tier's explicit `MARGIN ←` toggle tab.
suggested_fix: Decide deliberately whether ≥1440 gets a collapse control, or document that the rail is permanent.

title: The Receiving tab was never opened — project scoping unverified
observation: The Orders sheet's tab row includes `RECEIVING`, visible in the same shot used for T13, but no shot in this pass opens that tab, so whether a damage claim can be filed there without losing the open project's context was not confirmed.
suggested_fix: Open the Receiving tab directly and check for a project filter and a return path.

title: Free-text description prints in the same register as studio copy
observation: Below the Direction document's folio strip a paragraph reads `Draft fixture for a no-login household: proposals.designer_client_id links to the household so document_state Shape B rescues the client_name.` in the same body type as the rest of the paper, with no internal-note distinction.
suggested_fix: Give free-text descriptions a visual register distinct from studio-authored copy.

title: The two leaf routes name the project differently on the way back
observation: `w1440-leaf-plans-route`'s return link reads `← CHEN`; `w1440-leaf-specbook-route`'s reads `← CHEN RESIDENCE`. Neither says Desk or document.
suggested_fix: Use the document's full title in both return links.

title: Whether a ledger sheet preserves her place from a document is unverified
surface: Orders/Accounts/Hours sheet opened from an open document
observation: The Orders sheet opened from the Desk slid over a dimmed background; no shot in this pass opens it from inside a document, so whether the document stays mounted and scrolled to where she was rather than resetting was not confirmed.
suggested_fix: Open a ledger sheet from inside a document and confirm scroll and fold state survive.
